title: [Master][All-e][FTE][SaaS] Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using “Profile (Role)”.
summary: The Last Name field is now visible and editable on the Employee Relatives page, allowing users to view and modify employee relative information.
key_points: Added the missing Last Name field to the Employee Relatives page layout
The field was present in the underlying table but not exposed in the UI
Added automated tests to verify the field can be edited and saved
Fixes the issue where users could not access the last name field due to profile customization
